items.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can catch fire (recall)
items.job: Disconnect or replace switch and add fused jumper harness
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Spark plug blows out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert and replace plug and coil
items.note: Price is for one cylinder. If the head must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Spark plugs seize and break during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs and extract broken plugs
items.note: Each plug that breaks adds extraction time.

items.t: Cam phaser and timing chain rattle
items.job: Replace cam phasers, timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Cost rises if the oil pump or VCT solenoids also need replacing.

items.t: Transmission may suddenly downshift into first gear (recall)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: EcoBoost stumble or power loss in damp weather
items.job: Replace charge air cooler and update engine software
items.note: Some trucks are fixed with only a software update and an air deflector, which costs less.

items.t: Side doors may not latch or may open while driving (recall)
items.note: Price is per door. Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioners can start a fire in a crash (recall)
items.job: Remove B-pillar insulation and add heat shield
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cam phaser rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace cam phasers and timing chain kit
items.note: Ford bulletins or warranty may help; ask a dealer with your VIN before paying.

items.job: Update transmission software and run adaptive relearn
items.note: If internal parts are worn, a valve body or rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Parking brake may apply by itself (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace rear parking brake wiring harness
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor may stop working (recall)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle hub bolt can break (recall)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Camera menu can cover the backup camera image (recall)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.
